messages:
Sara: Quick sync — can we lock the cross-functional engineering+product weekly for RFC reviews + roadmap disputes? proposing Weds 9am PT. Draft agenda below, plz 👍

Alex: Weds 9am is tight for eng due to oncall rotations. Can we push to 10am PT? I can make 9:30 too.

Jordan: 10am PT works for design. Also request 20m for the UX decision on endpoint error states — it's longer than a quick call.

Mike: 10am PT is fine for platform. If we expand UX to 20m we should shorten the triage segment. Also: add a short infra rollout checklist review (3–5m) so the Dedicated rollout doesn't miss ops items.

Sara: Ok moving to 10am PT then. Updated draft agenda:```
1) RFC reviews (batching/cache) — 15m (Alex/Eng)
2) Roadmap disputes + decision log update — 15m (Sara/Priya)
3) UX endpoint error state (design decision) — 20m (Jordan)
4) Triage quick hits — 10m (eng leads)
5) Infra rollout checklist — 5m (Mike)
```

Nina: I can own notes + action tracker. Suggest we name owners inline so decisions get logged immediately. Also propose a standing pre-read 24h before (one-pager + relevant RFC link).

Priya: Agree on pre-read. I'll circulate the decision options for roadmap items by Tue EOD so we can vote async if needed. Also can we surface cost implications (per-token estimates) in the pre-read? Product needs that to prioritize.

Alex: I'll drop a short cost estimate section into the RFC for batching/cache. If folks want numbers sooner I can paste a rough calc in the thread.

Jordan: For the UX piece I uploaded a quick Figma flow — link in #design. Will mark the exact screens in the pre-read.

Sara: Awesome. Owners: RFCs (Alex), Roadmap decisions (Priya + Sara), UX (Jordan), Triage (Alex + Mike), Infra checklist (Mike). Nina will take notes. Calendar invite to follow.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Cross-functional Eng/Product Sync — Wed 10:00am PT (60m). Attendees: Sara, Alex, Jordan, Mike, Priya, Nina. Link: https://calendar.example/redwood/cf-sync

Alex: One more ask — can we add a 5m guardrail: if roadmap dispute needs more time, we escalate to async decision with a 72h deadline and owner assigned. Avoids meeting overruns.

Sara: Yes — add to agenda rules. If no consensus in 72h, Priya will make a call and update decision log.

Mike: Noted. I'll bring the infra checklist and a short rollback playbook for the Dedicated rollout.

Nina: I'll post the meeting notes template in the calendar invite and set reminders: pre-read 24h, final agenda 2h.

Priya: Thanks — I'll send the roadmap options Tue EOD.

Sara: Thanks team — closing thread. See you Weds 10am PT. :raised_hands:
